events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Dennis Hildeby made 29 saves for the first shutout of his NHL career as the Toronto Maple Leafs blanked the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dennis Hildeby earns his first NHL shutout as Maple Leafs blank Lightning 2-0

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Joel Armia scored twice, Adrian Kempe had a goal and assist, and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Utah Mammoth 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Armia scores 2, Kempe has goal and assist as Kings beat Mammoth 4-2

headlines.description: — Yegor Sharangovich had two goals and an assist, and linemate Nazem Kadri added a goal and two assists to lead the surging Calgary Flames over the Buffalo Sabres 7-4 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharangovich and Kadri lead surging Flames to 7-4 win over Sabres

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — John Gibson made 39 saves for his first NHL shutout in nearly three years, and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gibson gets 1st shutout in almost 3 years as Red Wings blank Canucks 4-0

headlines.description: — Joel Eriksson Ek had a goal and two assists, and the Minnesota Wild scored three times in the third period to beat the Seattle Kraken 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eriksson Ek has goal and 2 assists as Wild score 3 in 3rd period to beat Kraken 4-1
